1  -2-  MFA No. 202043 of 2015  THIS MFA IS FILED U/S. 173(1) OF MV ACT PRAYING TO ALLOW THE ABOVE MISC.
FIRST APPEAL AND CONSEQUENTLY BE PLEASED TO MODIFY THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 30.07.2015 PASSED BY THE II ADDL.

SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MACT AT KALABURAGI, IN MVC NO.80/2013 AND CONSEQUENTLY BE PLEASED TO DISCHARGE THE APPELLANT FROM ITS LIABILITY TO PAY THE COMPENSATION AND ALSO BE PLEASED TO REDUCE THE COMPENSATION SUITABLY.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT Heard on admission.

2. The learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the appellant took specific contention that guardian of respondent No.1 has stated that her daughter and their friends while coming from school, boarded the tractor and trailor and due to the rash and negligent driving of the tractor, the daughter fell down from the tractor, the inmates of the tractor sustained injuries.
That there is a clear violation of terms of the policy.
However, the tribunal has fastened the liability upon the Insurance company.
Hence, sought for allow this appeal.
3. I have carefully gone through the judgment of MACT.

The tribunal has observed that to substantiate the case of the claimant, the minor guardian has examined as PW.1 and 18 documents got marked as Exs.P.1 to 18 and respondent No.2 examined their Assistant Manager as RW1 and got marked 2 documents as Exs.R1 and 2.
After thorough investigation, the IO has submitted the charge sheet against the driver of the tractor for the offences punishable under Sections 279, 337, 338 of IPC R/w Section 187 of IMV Act.

IO has not submitted charge sheet under Section 192A of MV Act,
1988 for violation of permit condition.

Even if, it presume that the drive of the tractor violated the terms and conditions of the policy, then also, in view of decision of Hon'ble Apex court in the case of Pappu & Ors vs. Vinod Kumar Lamba & Another reported in AIR 2018 SC 592, the claimants are entitled to recover the compensation from Insurance company under the principle of pay and recovery.

entities.text: Pappu & Ors vs. Vinod Kumar Lamba & Another reported in AIR 2018 SC 592
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Viewed from any angel, I do not find legal infirmities in the impugned judgment and award passed by the tribunal.

Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER Appeal is not admitted and the same is dismissed.
Sd/-
JUDGE BH The Divisional Manager vs Mahalaxmi D/O. Mallikarjuna on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127529676/
